reason: B proposes the more physically credible contrast: an external Cr-rich protective scale at higher oxygen potential versus selective internal oxidation of highly oxygen-affine solutes at low oxygen potential, with microscopy and mechanical testing able to distinguish them. It remains incomplete because oxygen partial pressure/dew point must be specified and Ti-scale protectiveness is questionable, but A’s assumed thick nonprotective Al–Ti scale in air, omission of likely Cr involvement, and weakly decisive falsification rule are larger deficiencies.
